## 2. Core Technical Competencies & Architectural Capabilities

### A. Web Automation Engineering (Playwright & Python)
- **Framework**: Playwright with Python 3.10+, Pytest, and Page Object Model (POM).
- **Execution Engine**: Headless and headed cross-browser test execution across Chromium, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple WebKit.
- **Locator Resilience**: Primary reliance on user-facing semantic locators (`page.get_by_role`, `page.get_by_label`, `page.get_by_test_id`) with strict web-first assertion contracts (`expect(locator).to_be_visible()`, `to_have_text()`).
- **Debugging & Artifacts**: Playwright Trace Viewer (`trace.zip`), full-page screenshot captures on failure, network request HAR archives, and live console log recording.
- **Data-Driven Testing**: Parameterized testing via Pytest fixtures, external JSON/CSV dataset injection, and dynamic test matrix execution.

### B. API Testing & Automation (REST, GraphQL, Postman, Newman)
- **Playwright APIRequestContext**: High-speed headless HTTP automation validating status codes, response headers, schema strictness, and CRUD persistence.
- **Postman & Newman CLI**: Enterprise collection design, pre-request scripts, automated test assertions, environmental variable inheritance, mock servers, and CI runner integration.
- **Contract & Schema Validation**: Pydantic v2 and JSON Schema validation ensuring API backward compatibility and preventing data contract drift.

### C. Performance & Scalability Profiling (Apache JMeter)
- **Load Testing**: Thread group modeling, ramp-up schedules, constant throughput timers, and concurrency stress testing.
- **Metrics Analysis**: Response time percentiles (p90, p95, p99), latency waterfalls, error rates, throughput (TPS), and server resource bottleneck diagnosis.

### D. Manual Testing & STLC Governance
- **Test Case Design Techniques**: Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, and Error Guessing.
- **Defect Lifecycle Management**: Structured bug reporting via Jira, reproducible steps to reproduce (STR), severity vs. priority matrices, root-cause analysis (RCA), and regression sign-off.
- **Deliverables**: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), Master Test Plans (MTP), Defect Status Reports, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) documentation.

## 3. Flagship QA Frameworks & Production Repositories

### 1. SauceDemo Enterprise Automation Testing Framework
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/saucedemo-playwright-automation
- **Live HTML Interactive Report**: https://tanzimsqa.github.io/saucedemo-playwright-automation/
- **Stack**: Python, Playwright, Pytest, Page Object Model (POM), GitHub Actions.
- **Key Modules**:
  - `LoginPage`: Authentication permutations (valid, locked, invalid, empty).
  - `InventoryPage`: Product catalog, multi-criteria sorting (A-Z, Z-A, low-high, high-low), add-to-cart sync.
  - `CartPage`: Cart item quantity, removal persistence, badge badge updates.
  - `CheckoutPages`: 3-step checkout flow, field validation, dynamic 8% tax calculation, and order dispatch confirmation.
- **CI/CD Automation**: Automated schedule running daily at 10:00 AM BST (04:00 UTC) with artifact publishing.

### 2. Playwright REST API Test Automation Framework
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/playwright-api-testing-framework
- **Live HTML Interactive Report**: https://tanzimsqa.github.io/playwright-api-testing-framework/
- **Stack**: Python 3.10+, Playwright `APIRequestContext`, Pytest, Pydantic v2, Service Object Model (SOM).
- **Key Modules**:
  - `AuthService`: Token retrieval, session header injection, expired token negative testing.
  - `ProductService`: CRUD verification, pagination checks, limit/skip slicing, payload integrity.
  - `CartService`: Order creation, payload schema validation, mathematical total assertions.
- **Email Reporting**: Automated dispatch of HTML test summary to QA Lead (`tanzimsqa@gmail.com`) upon pipeline execution.

### 3. Bangladesh Railway Web Application Manual Testing Documentation
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TanzimSQA/Manual-Testing-For-BANGLADESH-Railway-Web-Application
- **Asset Scope**: Real-world e-ticketing platform manual testing suite.
- **Documentation Included**: Full RTM, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, Bug Reports, and Verification Proofs for ticket search, passenger seat selection, payment gateway routing, and booking confirmation.

## 6. SQA Taxonomy Series (Guides #41–#54)
- **Guide #41: Playwright storageState & Authentication Session Reuse**: Captures session tokens and cookies into JSON fixtures to bypass repeated UI logins, reducing CI execution duration by 70%.
- **Guide #42: Asynchronous Event & Message Queue Verification**: End-to-end event testing across RabbitMQ and Kafka validating at-least-once delivery, consumer idempotency, and Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) routing.
- **Guide #43: Persistence Layer & Database State Assertions in API Automation**: Direct SQL verification against relational test databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) pairing HTTP assertions with true backend record state.
- **Guide #44: Chaos Testing & Network Fault Injection with Playwright**: Intercepting network traffic and simulating degraded mobile connections (3G) or HTTP 503 gateway outages via `page.route` to verify graceful UI degradation.

---

- **Guide #45: Accessibility Automation with Axe-Core in Playwright CI Pipelines**: Automated WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance verification inside pull request pipelines scanning rendered DOM trees for contrast ratios, ARIA contracts, and keyboard tab traps.
- **Guide #46: GraphQL API Automation and Query Depth Auditing**: Dynamic GraphQL mutation testing with Postman and Newman, coupled with automated security regression suites against query depth recursion limits and schema introspection vulnerabilities.

- **Guide #47: Observability-Driven QA and OpenTelemetry Trace Correlation**: Shift-right testing injecting W3C traceparent headers into Playwright automated tests to correlate client-side UI failures directly with backend microservice Jaeger traces.
- **Guide #48: Zero-Trust API Authentication and JWT Expiry Simulation**: Postman and Newman automated testing framework simulating short-lived access token lifecycles, automated refresh rotation, and RFC 6750 401 Unauthorized boundary handling.

- **Guide #49: Mutation Testing with Mutmut & Stryker for Test Suite Robustness**: Intentional injection of source code mutants to evaluate test assertion efficacy beyond superficial 100% code coverage in SQA automation.
- **Guide #50: Stateful Property-Based Testing with Hypothesis**: Generative test automation framework asserting universal mathematical/business invariants with automated failure shrinking to catch edge-case combinatorial defects.

- **Guide #51: Database Transaction Concurrency & Deadlock Testing**: Multi-threaded test harness in Pytest simulating parallel write operations to validate row-level locks, ACID isolation levels, and automated deadlock retry resilience.
- **Guide #52: Contract-Driven Microfrontends Testing with Webpack Module Federation**: Playwright automated verification of host-to-remote Module Federation interfaces, singleton shared dependency resolution, and graceful fallback error boundaries under remote outages.

- **Guide #53: WebSocket Real-Time Event & State Synchronization Testing**: Playwright duplex frame interception validating WebSocket JSON schemas, ping-pong keepalives, and automatic exponential backoff reconnection recovery.
- **Guide #54: Synthetic Production Monitoring with Playwright**: Shift-right automated QA executing recurring headless browser user journeys against production endpoints to enforce SLA timings and detect third-party service dropouts.
- **Guide #55: Compliance & Regulatory Testing (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS)**: Risk-driven statutory verification covering immutable audit logs, PII data masking, Right to be Forgotten deletion protocols, and PCI-DSS payment tokenization.
- **Guide #56: Performance Test Types (Load, Stress, Spike, Soak)**: Decomposing enterprise performance engineering across baseline load, stress threshold limits, spike traffic surges, and 24-72 hour endurance soak testing.
- **Guide #57: Response Time & Latency SLAs (P90, P95, P99 Percentiles)**: Latency SLA verification in performance testing: why averages mislead engineering teams and how P95/P99 tail latencies pinpoint database pool contention.
- **Guide #58: 5 Core Principles of REST APIs in Backend SQA**: Technical evaluation of statelessness, client-server decoupling, cacheability contracts, and uniform interface boundaries in automated API testing.
- **Guide #59: Anatomy of an API Request in Backend QA**: Deconstructing HTTP method semantics, authentication bearer token headers, content-type negotiation, and URL query parameter boundary testing.
- **Guide #60: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation & Tenant-Leak Testing**: Cross-tenant penetration suites validating PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS), asserting 404 response boundaries against IDOR/BOLA attacks, and preventing Redis cache key cross-tenant pollution in shared-resource SaaS architectures.
- **Guide #61: gRPC Service & Protocol Buffers Automation**: Enterprise gRPC automated testing with pytest-grpc and BloomRPC: asserting canonical StatusCode semantics, validating Protobuf backward compatibility with buf breaking, and testing HTTP/2 stream multiplexing.
- **Guide #62: Mobile Web Touch Gesture & Viewport Emulation with Playwright**: Cross-device responsive test automation in Playwright: simulating touch events, deviceScaleFactor, viewport orientation shifts, and mobile CLS stability.
- **Guide #63: Automated SAST & DAST Pipeline Integration in CI/CD**: DevSecOps quality gates in GitHub Actions: Semgrep static analysis, containerized OWASP ZAP dynamic scanning, and SARIF pull request reporting.
- **Guide #64: Kafka Consumer Lag & Rebalance Testing**: Distributed stream testing: profiling consumer lag thresholds, validating CooperativeStickyAssignor rebalance resilience, and poison pill DLT routing in Kafka.
- **Guide #65: Automated Visual Regression Testing with Playwright**: Pixel-perfect snapshot diffing: golden baseline management, dynamic component masking, subpixel antialiasing thresholds, and containerized CI parity.
- **Guide #66: Flaky Test Root-Cause Engineering & Quarantine Architecture**: Test suite reliability engineering: diagnosing asynchronous timing race conditions, eliminating blind retry masking, implementing pytest test quarantine gates, and tracking flake rate SLAs.
- **Guide #67: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing for Microservices with Pact**: Decoupling integration verification with Pact, autonomous provider verification, pact broker contracts, and can-i-deploy release gates in CI/CD.
- **Guide #68: Synthetic Production Canary Probing with Playwright & Sentry Alerts**: Shift-right SQA engineering: orchestrating scheduled headless Playwright user journeys in production, emitting P95 latency telemetry, capturing HAR logs and failure screenshots in Sentry, and automating canary rollback circuit breakers.
- **Guide #69: Distributed Tracing & Context Propagation in Microservice API Testing**: End-to-end observability testing in microservices: injecting W3C traceparent and baggage headers, correlating distributed spans with OpenTelemetry and Jaeger, validating microservice latency budgets, and enforcing downstream SLA gates in pytest.
- **Guide #70: Chaos Engineering & Network Latency Injection in QA Automation**: Full-stack resilience testing: simulating socket timeouts and TCP packet loss with Toxiproxy, verifying circuit breaker state transitions (closed, open, half-open), and asserting graceful browser fallbacks with Playwright route aborts.
